demo.title: Try KLARIN
demo.text: The owl has prepared eight short tasks: counting, clapping syllables, finding, reading and a maze. Everything is read aloud. Please turn the sound on.
demo.private: The preview saves nothing – no profile, no data.
demo.end_text: In the app, tasks adapt to each child and to each skill separately. The child can start playing straight away – the app guides them by voice through choosing a friend. Parents create an account on the start screen and sign in with it on another tablet or phone too – the children's profiles come along. We are testing the Android and iOS apps right now.

advice.outside: Slower strokes and bigger letters help (in the air, on a board).
advice.missing: Remind the child to look at the whole letter when done.
advice.start: Before writing, point to where the letter starts.
advice.direction: Trace the letter together in the air or on the back, in the right direction.
advice.order: Name the strokes aloud: “first down, then the curve”.
advice.open: Practise closed circles and curves (sun, ball).
advice.size: Remind about the lines: the letter touches the lines.
advice.extra: Slowly, with a pause before each stroke.
